changelog:
* **fix: build font fallback families from font lists** (d702b07)
  - FontFamily does not expose its fonts as a List in this Compose
    version, so drop the toList() calls on family instances
  - Build the Bangla fallback chain from the source List<Font> entries
    instead (FontFamily(fonts) factory), keeping public API unchanged
* **feat: add app font picker with live preview and apply** (66d8abc)
  - Add Font row to the General settings group (shows current font)
  - New SettingsSection.FONT full-page: font option cards, live preview
    rendered in the pending font, and an info card explaining the option
  - Preview mirrors the App Theme flow: pending selection, Apply bottom
    bar, haptic feedback, and discard-confirm dialog on back
  - Persist AppFont in DataStore (app_font key); thread fontFlow through
    MainActivity into CashFigureTheme
  - Ship Google Sans Rounded, Google Sans Flex and Volte Round in
    res/font; Bangla mode chains the custom font over Tiro Bangla so
    Bengali glyphs always fall back to Tiro (custom fonts are Latin-only)
  - Remove the three TTF sources from the root assets folder
* **feat: restyle draft cards with words and drop calculator action** (74963b5)
  - Remove the load-into-calculator icon from draft cards and its nav wiring
  - Move the grand total amount below the draft title as a bold primary line
  - Add the amount in words below the meta line (Taka Only / টাকা মাত্র)
  - Convert the Bangla draft title number to Bangla digits (ড্রাফট #৩)
